where.if: (dict_key LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dict (dict_key, name, category, version, status, folder_id, published_at, published_by, review_comment, source, source_ref) VALUES (#{dictKey}, #{name}, #{category}, #{version}, #{status}, #{folderId}, #{publishedAt}, #{publishedBy}, #{reviewComment}, #{source}, #{sourceRef})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dict WHERE dict_key = #{dictKey} ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, version DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM dict WHERE dict_key = #{dictKey} AND version = #{version} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM dict WHERE dict_key = #{dictKey} ORDER BY version DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM dict WHERE dict_key = #{dictKey} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(version) FROM dict WHERE dict_key = #{dictKey} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT * FROM dict WHERE dict_key = #{dictKey} ORDER BY version DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE dict SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dict SET status = 'ARCHIVED' WHERE dict_key = #{dictKey} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND id != #{excludeId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dict WHERE folder_id = #{folderId}
